# Genuine source subset — character scope only

Two records were extracted programmatically from `data/characters.json` at
https://github.com/xkhanhs/hsk-sino-viet/tree/7cd2805fb0bb46f8e21bda364b857759465f1ce2.
The selected fields retain their source text. Other fields and records were omitted.
The manifest records the original artifact checksum and the different subset checksum.
These are character annotations, not reviewed lexical translations or a complete dictionary.

Attribution: Data from the Kai Hanzi HSK × Sino-Vietnamese dataset,
https://kaihanzi.com/chu. License: CC BY 4.0,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (legal code:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode).
Commercial redistribution and adaptation are allowed subject to attribution, license/change
notices and no added restrictions. The upstream LICENSE and NOTICE were inspected; its
NOTICE identifies these fields as the publisher's work and excludes stroke geometry.
No stroke, radical, mnemonic, HSK or curriculum data is imported. Publisher claims of manual
authorship are preserved as provenance, not represented as independent linguistic review.
